meta.method: Official Higgsfield contest, CPP, community and case-study pages; official creator profiles (higgsfield.ai/@username) for socials; PR Newswire and AWN for named winners; live X user lookup for handles that exist on X; GASP for the Action Scene honourable-mention username list. No handles or awards were invented. Instagram/TikTok/YouTube links taken from official Higgsfield profiles were not all HTTP-opened (those sites often block unauthenticated fetch); they are recorded as listed on the official profile.

counts.shortfall_note: Did not pad the list with invented people. Remaining slots should stay empty or be filled only with later-verified names.
